title: Space to pass and sit by the shop street
caption: Pedestrians can pass the held izakaya conversation in both directions; the paired seafront benches have usable space beside the rail.

sections.title: Held conversation
sections.caption: Actual two-minute waits: desktop 6/14 and phone 7/7 completed passes in opposite directions, with neither speaker moved. Unchanged overlap, spin and gait checks report no episodes.

sections.title: Both sides of the seafront benches
sections.caption: The pairs sit 0.65 m farther inland. Both protagonists walked around the ends and reached the rail-side and shop-side approaches.
